infrastructure.tasks/campaign/lean_slot.sh: CPU semaphore for Lean jobs (mkdir-based, stale-slot reclamation by PID)
infrastructure.tasks/campaign/lean_check.sh: elaborate a file against the prebuilt library, read-only, holding a slot
infrastructure.tasks/campaign/verify_module_local.sh: local replacement for verify_module.sbatch; compiles into a private olean and audits the FRESH artifact
infrastructure.tasks/campaign/audit_module.py: discovers a module's own declarations from its olean (Lean.ModuleData.constNames) and audits their axioms
infrastructure.tasks/campaign/verify_all_local.sh: the authoritative full pipeline: build, tests, field-map pins, axiom audit, integrity checks

notes: The cluster's verify_module.sbatch audited `import <mod>` through the shared LEAN_PATH, which resolved to the STALE prebuilt olean; a candidate with `sorry` could pass. The local script puts the private output directory FIRST on LEAN_PATH and proves freshness by the sorry self-test.
Lake in this toolchain (5.0.0) has no -j/--jobs option; build parallelism is bounded indirectly with LEAN_NUM_THREADS.
Another campaign (BioNetGen, /private/tmp/bng3-campaign) runs on the same Mac and uses 4-5 cores; it is never signalled. The load budget was reduced accordingly.
